followup_and_control_entries.result: heterogeneous reduction in confluence; corroborating cancer-cell growth inhibition
followup_and_control_entries.limit: RCC407 fitted IC50 31.4 uM exceeds highest tested 10 uM; no normal-cell or MVA benefit tested.
followup_and_control_entries.source: Supplementary Figure 2g-h, page 7; Source Data Supplementary Figure 2 rows324-407
followup_and_control_entries.ledger_action: separate compound occurrence with bounded cancer-growth appraisal; no promotion

followup_and_control_entries.name: MS094
followup_and_control_entries.result: broadly tracks control growth; 786-0 inactive-control curve absent
followup_and_control_entries.limit: Author response says 786-0 MS094 curve not generated for technical reasons; not a six-model paired-control result.
followup_and_control_entries.source: Figure 1b; Supplementary Figure 2e; Peer Review File page6
followup_and_control_entries.ledger_action: negative-control identity entry; no therapeutic efficacy credit
